About Vanguard Transport

Building Trust, One Load at a Time

Founded in 2003, Vanguard Transport Inc. is a Milton-based, family-operated dry van carrier with over two decades of proven freight service across Canada and the United States.

🏆
New & Well-Maintained Equipment
Our equipment is regularly refreshed and kept to the highest maintenance standards — so your freight moves without delays or breakdowns.
🛡️
C-TPAT & FAST Certified
Fully compliant for cross-border freight with CVOR, US DOT, MC number, and customs security program certifications.
📍
Strategically Located in Milton
At the heart of Canada's freight corridor — minutes from Highway 410, 427, and 401, with direct access to US border crossings.

What We Do

Our Services

We specialize in one thing and we do it better than anyone — dry van freight across Canada and the United States.

Core Service
📦

Dry Van Transport

Our 53' dry van trailers protect your freight from the elements. From palletized goods to boxed products — if it ships dry, we move it.

🇨🇦🇺🇸

Cross-Border Canada–USA

Licensed, bonded, and experienced in cross-border moves. We handle customs paperwork and compliance so you don't have to. Seamless freight, every time.

🗺️

Long Haul & Dedicated Lanes

Ontario to Quebec, Alberta, the Maritimes, and throughout the US. We run the lanes consistently — which means predictable transit times for you.

Vanguard Power Units

New, well-maintained equipment built to industry standards, running every day.

Coverage Area

Canada & USA — We Go There

From our base in Milton, Ontario, we run freight across the country and into the United States. No lane too long, no load too routine.

🔵
Ontario → Quebec / Montreal
Canada's highest volume corridor — we run it regularly
🔵
Ontario → Alberta / Western Canada
Long haul, premium rates, consistent return freight
🔵
Ontario → Maritime Provinces
East coast freight handled with care
🇺🇸
Canada → USA (Cross-Border)

GTA Regional & Dedicated Lanes
